QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Dawn Warrior
QuestInfo.0: The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Dawn Warrior, the Swordsman of light, talk to the #bChief Knight of Light #p1101003##k.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to become a brilliant, glorious #bDawn Warrior#k of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101003#.
QuestInfo.2: You are now a Dawn Warrior!

0.0: I am #p1101003#, #bChief Knight of the Light#k, leader of the #bDawn Warriors#k. If you pursue the path of the Dawn Warrior, you will be under my command.
0.1: A Dawn Warrior is more than a Warrior. We are swordsmen and swordswomen of light! We deal with enemies head on, relying on our strength and stamina to win the day!
0.2: We are blessed by #bSoul, the spirit of light#k. If you join us, Soul will become your combat partner and guardian, always by your side in battle.
0.3: Only those who possess a burning heart, sharp eyes, an even sharper blade, and undying loyalty to the empress are suited to be Dawn Warriors. Let me know if you wish to pursue this glorious path!

yes.0: Make a decision that you will not regret.
